question: What is the total salary paid by team Boston Red Stockings in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.salary) FROM baseball_1_salary AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name = 'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year = 2010
generated_sql:
WITH target_team AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        team_id,
        league_id
    FROM baseball_1_team
    WHERE year = 2010
      AND name = 'Boston Red Stockings'
),
salary_by_team AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        team_id,
        league_id,
        SUM(salary) AS total_salary
    FROM baseball_1_salary
    WHERE year = 2010
      AND salary IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        year,
        team_id,
        league_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(sbt.total_salary), 0) AS total_salary_paid
FROM target_team tt
LEFT JOIN salary_by_team sbt
    ON tt.year = sbt.year
   AND tt.team_id = sbt.team_id
   AND tt.league_id = sbt.league_id;

question: Find the name and id of the team that won the most times in 2008 postseason.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, T1.team_id_winner FROM baseball_1_postseason AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id_winner = T2.team_id_br WHERE T1.year = 2008 GROUP BY T1.team_id_winner ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH team_postseason_wins AS (
    SELECT
        team_id_winner AS team_id,
        SUM(wins) AS total_wins
    FROM baseball_1_postseason
    WHERE year = 2008
    GROUP BY team_id_winner
)
SELECT
    t.name AS team_name,
    t.team_id AS team_id
FROM team_postseason_wins tpw
JOIN baseball_1_team t
    ON t.team_id = tpw.team_id
   AND t.year = 2008
ORDER BY
    tpw.total_wins DESC,
    t.team_id
LIMIT 1;

question: Which players won awards in both 1960 and 1961? Return their first names and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name_first, T1.name_last FROM baseball_1_player AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_player_award AS T2 ON TRUE WHERE T2.year = 1960 INTERSECT SELECT T1.name_first, T1.name_last FROM baseball_1_player AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_player_award AS T2 ON TRUE WHERE T2.year = 1961
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.name_first AS first_name,
  p.name_last AS last_name
FROM baseball_1_player AS p
JOIN baseball_1_player_award AS pa
  ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
WHERE pa.year IN (1960, 1961)
GROUP BY
  p.player_id,
  p.name_first,
  p.name_last
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.year) = 2
ORDER BY
  p.name_last,
  p.name_first;

question: Which park had most attendances in 2008?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.park_name FROM baseball_1_home_game AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_park AS T2 ON T1.park_id = T2.park_id WHERE T1.year = 2008 ORDER BY T1.attendance DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH attendance_by_park AS (
    SELECT
        hg.park_id,
        SUM(hg.attendance) AS total_attendance
    FROM baseball_1_home_game AS hg
    WHERE hg.year = 2008
      AND hg.attendance IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY hg.park_id
),
ranked_parks AS (
    SELECT
        abp.park_id,
        p.park_name,
        p.city,
        p.state,
        abp.total_attendance,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY abp.total_attendance DESC) AS attendance_rank
    FROM attendance_by_park AS abp
    JOIN baseball_1_park AS p
      ON abp.park_id = p.park_id
)
SELECT
    park_id,
    park_name,
    city,
    state,
    total_attendance
FROM ranked_parks
WHERE attendance_rank = 1
ORDER BY park_name, park_id;

question: Which film has the most number of actors or actresses? List the film name, film id and description.

    SELECT
        fa.film_id,
        COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
    FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS fa

question: Return the ids of all products that were ordered more than three times or supplied more than 80000.
gold_sql: SELECT product_id FROM department_store_Order_Items GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 UNION SELECT product_id FROM department_store_Product_Suppliers GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(total_amount_purchased) > 80000
generated_sql:
WITH ordered_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM customers_and_products_contacts_Order_Items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
),
supplied_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) AS supplied_count
    FROM department_store_Product_Suppliers
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND total_amount_purchased IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(total_amount_purchased, '$', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) > 80000
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        product_id
    FROM customers_and_products_contacts_Products
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    p.product_id AS product_id
FROM product_ids p
LEFT JOIN ordered_products op
    ON p.product_id = op.product_id
LEFT JOIN supplied_products sp
    ON p.product_id = sp.product_id
WHERE op.product_id IS NOT NULL
   OR sp.product_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.product_id;

question: What is the last name of the first individual contacted from the organization with the maximum UK Vat number across all organizations?

    FROM e_government_Organizations
    WHERE uk_vat_number IS NOT NULL
),

    SELECT
        oci.organization_id,
        oci.individual_id,

    WHERE oci.date_contact_from IS NOT NULL
)
